contract.title: Incremental status evidence audit
contract.objective: Read-only audit src/observation.js and src/status.js for incremental state, owner absence and historical attempt evidence consistency. At most two new findings. No file writes or nested agents.
acceptance: Check incremental observation and owner/history consistency; cite file:line, trigger, expected/actual and evidence for each finding, or enumerate checked branches when none found.
Separate confirmed bugs, unverified hypotheses and design limitations; provide minimal upgrade recommendations and acceptance checks, identifying unrun verification.
context: S1 strict generation schema and S2 receipt fixes are already present. Do not repeat them.

Static evidence or pure in-memory checks satisfy this contract. Captain owns filesystem fixtures, tests and shared STATUS documentation. Completed-report verification boundaries belong in limitations.
For confirmed findings give file:line, trigger, expected/actual, evidence type and minimal reproduction, explicitly naming whether executed. Avoid gitignored contents.

selection.reason: complex, uncertain, review or no simple model selected

result.summary: 安老板，本轮确认 1 个新 P2 缺陷：独立审查期间的增量摘要会继续返回写成员的旧动作。owner 缺席和历史 attempt 证据关联的已检查分支符合预期。审计对象为主目录 /Users/anshunli1/asl/code/github/codex-agent-teams 的当前源码，HEAD 25e15c7；未写文件、改变暂存状态或启动子 Agent，未重复 S1/S2。

criteria.criterion: Check incremental observation and owner/history consistency; cite file:line, trigger, expected/actual and evidence for each finding, or enumerate checked branches when none found.
criteria.evidence: 发现包含位置、触发、预期/实际、证据类型和已执行复现。卡恩实际执行纯内存检查，最终命令 exit 0：验证游标无变化、篡改、重连及跨项目/任务/attempt 拒绝；验证 running/integrating × owner 缺席/死亡/存活 × 有无结束时间，共 12 种组合；验证 compact/overview 耗时一致、owner 缺席时提示勿重复启动，以及历史 attempt 按各自 workspaceId 解析成员和集成验证状态。相关实现：src/observation.js:18、src/status.js:92、src/status.js:145。

criteria.criterion: Separate confirmed bugs, unverified hypotheses and design limitations; provide minimal upgrade recommendations and acceptance checks, identifying unrun verification.
criteria.evidence: findings 仅列 1 个确认缺陷，并给出最小修补建议及验收检查。历史 workspace 未参与游标摘要的条件反例单列为未验证假设；时间增长不制造更新作为设计边界说明。纯内存执行方式、未运行的 SDK/持久化/真实模型验证均列于 limitations，不作为 blockers。

findings: [确认缺陷][P2] 独立审查动作更新后，增量 lastAction 仍指向写成员旧动作 — src/observation.js:38。触发：workspace-write 任务进入 independent_review，写成员 actions 已有完成动作，随后 machineReview.actions 收到新的审查动作。预期：变化摘要展示当前独立审查成员的动作，并明确动作所属角色；实际：unchanged=false、phase=independent_review，但 lastAction 仍从 attempt.actions 取写成员旧动作，审查动作完全缺席。证据类型：静态调用链与已执行的纯内存复现。src/app-server.js:248 发布 actions；src/runtime.js:202 将审查进度存入 machineReview；src/status.js:110 的完整视图能返回 reviewerActions，增量分支却只读取成员 actions。最小复现步骤：构造 running 任务，其最新 attempt 的 phase='independent_review'、actions.items=[{id:'writer',status:'completed'}]、machineReview={status:'running',actions:{items:[]}}；snapshot.owner.processAlive=true；首次 observe 获取 cursor；向 machineReview.actions.items 加入 {id:'reviewer',status:'inProgress'} 并更新 task.updatedAt；携带原 cursor 再次 observe。卡恩（本审计 Agent）实际执行：增量返回 lastAction.id='writer'，完整 observedTaskView 返回 reviewerActions 最后一项 id='reviewer'。最小建议：在独立审查阶段从 machineReview.actions 选择动作，增加角色标记；尚无审查动作时返回 null，避免呈现旧写成员动作。验收：分别检查审查动作开始、完成及审查动作为空，确保 changed 摘要与完整视图一致；成员阶段仍返回成员动作，重复观察仍为 unchanged。修补后的验收尚未运行。
limitations: 未验证假设：src/observation.js:19、src/observation.js:21 仅将最新 attempt 的 workspace 纳入变化摘要，而 src/status.js:92 会读取所有历史 attempt 的 workspace。卡恩已执行条件反例：仅修改旧 workspace 的验证状态，完整历史状态变化，但增量仍 unchanged=true。尚未确认正常运行时存在既不改变 task、最新 workspace，也不改变可见 owner 信息的历史证据更新路径，因此未将其列为确认缺陷。建议先明确历史证据是否不可变；若允许独立更新，再将历史关联证据纳入摘要，并验收旧证据变化能触发 changed、无关 workspace 变化不会触发 changed。
设计边界：游标比较记录内容，时间流逝本身不会触发 changed；因此 unchanged 响应不会刷新 elapsedMs、staleMs 或 stalled。这与已有无新记录语义一致，调用方若需要更新这些派生值，应显式查询完整快照。
纯内存检查实际执行了从两个目标文件读取的函数源码，通过 Node VM 移除 imports/exports 并注入原生 crypto/path，stub 了未参与检查的插件身份文件探测；未读取 ignored 依赖或状态数据。该证据覆盖函数逻辑，未验证原生模块加载、SDK 路由、SQLite 恢复、文件系统 fixture 或真实模型执行。
未运行现有测试套件、修补后回归或正式缓存验证。共享 STATUS 文档及持久化/SDK fixture 验证由 captain 负责；本轮只读审计已按静态与纯内存证据完成。

evidence.evidence: Captain read observation.js/status.js/runtime.js and independently reproduced the reviewer delta mismatch with native ESM imports: changed=true but lastAction=writer while full reviewerActions=reviewer. Owner/history checks are supported by cited source and existing tests; member VM checks are supplemental, not SDK verification.

evidence.criterion: Separate confirmed bugs, unverified hypotheses and design limitations; provide minimal upgrade recommendations and acceptance checks, identifying unrun verification.
evidence.evidence: Captain confirmed the report separates one reproducible defect from conditional history hypothesis and deliberate clock/cursor semantics; proposed fix and unrun verification boundaries are explicit. Schema request returned a real report with limitations and cleanupConfirmed=true. This approves the audit report, not future implementation.
